keyVerseDR: "Give glory to the Lord, for he is good: for his mercy endureth for ever." (Ps 107:1)

level1.title: This Week's Catholic Virtue: Gratitude
level1.story: Gratitude means noticing the good gifts in our lives and saying thank you to God and others.
level1.keyLine: Thank You, God, for You are good!
level1.heartIntro: Hang this sheet on the fridge and practice gratitude all week. On Saturday, talk together, write what you practiced, and a parent signs.
questions: What is one thing our family was most grateful for this week?
Whom can we thank next week?
actions: Hang this sheet on the fridge
level1.prayer: Thank You, Lord, for all Your gifts. Give me a grateful heart every day. Amen.

activity.title: Daily Action Checklist
activity.intro: Color a star each day, Monday through Saturday. Hang this sheet on the fridge and practice with your family. A parent signs at the end of the week.
items: MON: Thank God for your health when you wake
TUE: Thank the person who prepared your meal
WED: Thank a friend who helped you today
THU: Do your work gladly, without complaining
FRI: Thank God for something beautiful you see
SAT: Pray for your priest and catechist

level2.title: This Week's Catholic Virtue: Gratitude
level2.story: Gratitude means noticing the good things we have been given and feeling thankful. Everything good comes from God: our life, our family, food, friends, and faith. A grateful heart says thank you to God and to the people who help us, and it does not grumble. The word Eucharist means thanksgiving! At every Mass we thank God for His greatest gift, Jesus.
level2.keyLine: Thank You, God, for You are good!
level2.heartIntro: Hang this sheet on the fridge and practice gratitude all week. On Saturday, talk together, write what you practiced, and a parent signs.
questions: What is one thing our family was most grateful for this week?
How did God help us grow in gratitude?
actions: Hang this sheet on the fridge
level2.prayer: Thank You, Lord, for all Your gifts. Give me a grateful heart every day. Amen.

activity.title: Daily Action Checklist
activity.intro: Color a star each day, Monday through Saturday. Hang this sheet on the fridge and practice with your family. A parent signs at the end of the week.
items: MON: List three blessings before bed
TUE: Write a thank-you note to a teacher
WED: Thank a parent for something they do daily
THU: Go a whole day without complaining
FRI: Thank God for a hard thing that helped you
SAT: Say grace thoughtfully at every meal
